g.text: - user is able to upload a file of up to 100mb, get a
link back, and share that links
- user getting a shared link should be able to
download the file when clicking that link
- User can optionally pass max download count and
requests sent among multiple simultaneous request
- the system should be able to defend against upload
abuse with around 20 uploads per minute per IP.
- download latency: a user should be able to
download their file in under 10 minutes assuming max
